response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and distributed systems expertise with exposure to AI-agent infrastructure, but lacks explicit executive leadership experience, fintech domain depth, or a proven track record in scaling engineering organizations or architecting AI-native financial systems at the required scale.
strengths: Diverse technical background with hands-on experience in distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and AI-agent tooling (e.g., MCP code generators at re:cinq).
Proven ability to build and maintain complex, scalable platforms (e.g., GISCollective, open-source contributions) with a focus on observability and real-time data.
Strong software craftsmanship ethos, including TDD, CI/CD, and cross-functional collaboration, with a history of mentoring and knowledge-sharing.
concerns: No explicit executive leadership experience; current and past roles are primarily individual contributor or senior developer positions.
Limited demonstrated experience in fintech infrastructure (e.g., credit systems, regulatory compliance, or real-time risk modeling) or high-stakes AI deployment in regulated environments.
Agentic AI experience appears nascent (e.g., tooling contributions at re:cinq) rather than production-scale architecture ownership.
